description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brindle Shoat, adding {C}{C}.
When Brindle Shoat dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Brindle Shoat trigger, creating a 3/3 Boar creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Boar, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Brindle Shoat from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
